blurbs.find: One box for everything you want to follow.
blurbs.configure: Where it lives and whether it shows up in Home.
blurbs.done: It's already fetching. Nothing else to do.

anything.placeholder: Paste a link to a website, feed, repository, or profile…
anything.hint: Monfil finds the feed behind the link. For a handle, press Enter.

rss.placeholder: Paste a link to an RSS feed…
rss.hint: Monfil checks the link for an RSS feed.

youtube.placeholder: Paste a channel, handle, or video link…
youtube.hint: Paste a link, or enter a channel or handle and press Enter.

github.placeholder: Paste a repository or user link, or owner/repo…
github.hint: A repository gives its releases. A user or org gives its public activity. After owner/repo, press Enter.

gitlab.hint: Monfil follows the project's releases. Self-hosted GitLab works too.

hackernews.hint: news.ycombinator.com offers the front page and feeds filtered by points.

arxiv.hint: For example arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent. Monfil hides replaced papers.

bluesky.placeholder: Paste a profile link or handle…
bluesky.hint: Enter a handle such as @name.bsky.social and press Enter.

mastodon.placeholder: Paste a profile or tag link, or @user@host…
mastodon.hint: Enter a handle such as @user@mastodon.social and press Enter.

conference.hint: Format: topics in places, then press Enter. Separate items with commas. Places are optional, and online counts as a place. Examples: devops · kubernetes, cloud in France · java in Belgium, online. A developers.events link also works.

ats.placeholder: Paste a company's job board or careers page…
ats.hint: Works with Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Teamtailor and Personio boards. Coverage is not complete: other job systems are not supported yet. Monfil lists every open job of the company.

find.notFoundDetail: Couldn't find a feed at that address.
find.conferenceEmpty: No conference matches now. Monfil adds a card when a matching conference is announced.

configure.notFoundDetail: Go back to step 1 and try a different link.
configure.showHint: Uncheck for high-volume sources you'd rather visit on purpose.
